findings.title: Missing or legacy lineage facts can be accepted as verified and exported as a complete manifest
findings.reproduction: At exact candidate b4da81e23738d722efe12cf44f760531656690f3, construct an otherwise valid first-page ProvenanceLineagePage with the requested revision as one resolved depth-zero fact, nextCursor=null, a distinct valid UUIDv7 in missingRevisionIds, integrityState='verified', legacyEventCount=0, exportAllowed=true, and exportDenialReason=null. Return it from a fake transport to createCoreApiClient.lineage for the exact accepted cursor-zero query. The generated client accepts it because decodeProvenanceLineagePage checks exportAllowed only against denial null, while lineage() treats a resolved root as sufficient and never binds nonempty missingRevisionIds to integrity-review. Pass the result and accepted query to lineageManifestReady: it returns true because it checks terminal cursor, revision, direction, integrity, export flags, and item rights but not missingRevisionIds. exportLineageManifest then emits completeness='complete' and the UI enables export. Replacing the missing list with legacyEventCount=1 reaches the same result because neither the client nor readiness predicate binds legacy visibility to integrity-review. docs/architecture/provenance-contracts.md explicitly states that missing revisions and legacy bridges remain visible as an integrity-review state unsuitable for export or claim use. The honest Core currently emits that denial, but the generated client/renderer are the cross-process fail-closed boundary already hardened against other contradictory response authority in this task.
findings.required_remediation: Enforce the page-level semantic invariant at the generated-client boundary: any nonempty missingRevisionIds or nonzero legacyEventCount must carry integrityState='integrity-review', exportAllowed=false, and exportDenialReason='integrity-review'; conversely a verified/exportable page must have neither condition. Preserve this invariant monotonically across renderer merges by deriving integrity review from the accumulated missing list and maximum legacy count, not only from service flags. Make lineageManifestReady independently require missingRevisionIds.length===0 and legacyEventCount===0 before complete export. Add fake-transport first-page and continuation contradictions for missing and legacy states, actual renderer merge/export denials for each, and retain the honest real-Core missing-reference test plus the complete verified export success case.

closures.evidence: The exact empty same-cursor reproduction and a backward-cursor variant now fail at the generated-client boundary. A non-null cursor requires at least one returned fact, strict forward progress, and equality to requested cursor plus fact count. An empty terminal continuation with nextCursor=null passes through the generated client, mergeLineagePage retains accumulated facts and terminal null, and the renderer no longer exposes Load more. The generator emits exactly the checked-in guard and generated parity passed.

The exact R02 partial-export and integrity-reopening reproductions now fail closed. Export requires the immutable accepted cursor-zero query, matching revision/direction, terminal pagination, verified integrity, service export permission with no denial, and no denied/unknown item rights; the manifest binds the accepted depth/page bounds and terminal count. mergeLineagePage applies a monotonic join in which integrity-review and rights-restricted denial survive every later verified/allowed page. The newly isolated R03-F01 concerns contradictory missing/legacy authority that neither the client nor readiness predicate currently maps into that otherwise-correct monotonic join; it does not erase closure of the exact R02 reproductions.
